name: RC–B10–0157/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to help Syria rebuild after the fall of Bashar al-Assad's regime. It asks the EU to support a peaceful political transition that includes all religious and ethnic groups, women and civil society. It wants sanctions eased to help Syria's economy recover, more money for humanitarian aid and reconstruction, and justice for crimes committed under the old regime. The Parliament also urges Syria's new leaders to protect all civilians and break ties with Russia and Iran.

- The EU is asked to ease sanctions, fund rebuilding and keep giving aid to Syrians.
- Syrians inside the country and the 1.3 million refugees in the EU are affected.
- EU governments and the Commission now decide whether to act on these requests.
